integrity: The equality, proof, and computational verifier are included; numerical experiments are not used as a substitute for the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the first modular collision, alphabet size equal to field characteristic p, is classified. No claim for larger alphabets, nonuniform weights, or other left-regular bands; originality remains subject to full historical priority examination.
title: A unique modular Jordan defect at the prime-alphabet threshold for the free left-regular band
